output.question: Has Qualcomm announced layoffs?

passages.quote: The company has reportedly begun cutting jobs in India, with as many as 1,000 employees likely facing the axe.

Qualcomm will cut jobs globally in a "performance-focused reduction" following its annual employee reviews, CEO Cristiano Amon told staff in a memo on Monday reviewed by Reuters, with notifications set to begin in November.
The memo did not say how many jobs would be affected, and Reuters could not immediately determine the scale of the cuts.
Qualcomm declined to comment when contacted by India Today Tech.

output.answer: Yes—Qualcomm announced layoffs internally, and reporting published on November 11, 2026 says job cuts have begun in India. Reuters reported on October 20 that CEO Cristiano Amon had told employees of a global “performance-focused reduction,” with notifications starting in November. The memo did not specify a worldwide total, and Qualcomm declined to comment on India Today’s latest report.
caveats: The announcement cited here was an internal memo reported by Reuters; India Today said Qualcomm had made no further announcement after that memo.
The latest India layoffs and their estimated scale are media reports, not a company-confirmed total.
missing_fields: Confirmed worldwide number of jobs affected.

Reuters reported that CEO Cristiano Amon had announced global performance-focused layoffs to employees, with notifications set to begin in November.
The internal memo did not disclose how many jobs would be affected worldwide.
Qualcomm declined to comment when contacted by India Today Tech.
